note: v4 final setup, Unity side (Stage F, 2026-11-13, Nusrat; Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 13, declared before it was built). Read by TrialRunnerV4 only when TrialPlayV4 -finalSetting NAME is given. The numbers of a final (task, final seed, runs per setting, timeout, success radius) are NOT here: they are read from robot_vision/configs/v4/final_plan.json (Anisha's file, read only). No final run and no freeze are made by this file.
done_file_note: Written into a final session folder after its last run; one per setting, never overwritten. Not FINAL_DONE.json: Python's final_guard_v4.markers scans every folder under the output root for that name and would take a Unity file for the setting's evaluation. The guard also refuses a setting with Python's FINAL_RUN_DONE.json (key setting).
settings_note: B7 = plan (b), decided by Nusrat on 2026-11-13 in Anisha's absence, pending her confirmation (upgrade_design.md section 13; AUDIT.md section 15): every final uses the test look sunbox_f2 with the test clips, the only plan her unchanged guard_run accepts for all four settings. zoom_on and zoom_off differ only on the Python side (bridge.server --final-setting with control_zoom_on.json or control_zoom_off.json). unseen_look is a REPEAT of zoom_on (same configs; a repeatability measure); the unseen-look question is answered by comparing the finals with the development results. In bystanders every person wears sunbox_f2, so the commander is told apart only by behaviour.
freeze_files_note: B9 (AUDIT.md section 14.7, Nusrat): the Unity files of the v4 scene to freeze, as repository paths. Anisha adds them to configs/v4/frozen.json the way the v3 Unity files were added; a final is refused unless every file is recorded there (looked up by this path in any of its hash tables) with its LF-normalised SHA-256. Code is pinned by the commit in session.json. The avatar look assets are third-party and not in git, so they are not hashed; each session records their appearance text.
